title: Legal acts
lead: The laws, resolutions and orders the archive works under: requisites, status, a link to the official publication and the file where it is open.

legend.title: What the statuses mean
legend.amended: The act has been amended or supplemented. Read the current version.
legend.expired: The act has been repealed or replaced and no longer applies.

official.title: Official texts
official.text: Only the texts published in the Adilet legal information system are legally binding. Check the current version before relying on an act.

checkedNote: A check date is shown for acts verified against the official publication.
